open_coverage_gaps: The new all_surfaces tests provide a shared five-entry-point matrix for their listed representative cases, including offsets, selected unary families, scalar spellings and relational operators. They do not enumerate the full Cartesian product of scalar/type/operator options, nor do they make every distinct source rebinding and validation case run through all five entry points.
Catalog entries and mocked workflow declaration/dispatch tests do not establish runtime behavior.

Dedicated native Session/Relation tests for directory/manifest membership rebinding and invalid unary metadata are narrower than all_surfaces; broad claims must stay attached to the exact listed methods and assertions.
